Class QuizAttemptService

java.lang.Object
com.codependentvariables.aiandme.services.QuizAttemptService
public class QuizAttemptService extends Object
Service layer for handling quiz attempts. Coordinates between the UI and the data access layer to save and retrieve quiz attempt data.
